净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： This factor preserves the volatility-regime switching intuition of the parent by comparing 20-day rolling volatility to its 60-day median, but replaces the raw 10-day price change with a smoothed exponential moving average (EMA) of close. The EMA reduces noise and improves rank stability, targeting the RankIC bottleneck while maintaining the core regime-dependent momentum/mean-reversion hypothesis

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

regime = sign(vol_20 - med_vol_60); factor = regime * (close - ewm_mean(10, close))
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

算子

算子含义

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

regime = sign(vol_20 - med_vol_60); factor = regime * (close - ewm_mean(10, close))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：subtract(vol_20, med_vol_60) → 减法：x - y
  2. 步骤2：sign(v1(subtract)) → 返回符号：正数返回1，负数返回-1，零返回0
  3. 步骤3：ewm_mean(close) → 窗口 10 的EMA 指数移动平均
  4. 步骤4：subtract(close, v3(ewm_mean)) → 减法：x - y
  5. 步骤5：multiply(v2(sign), v4(subtract)) → 乘法：x × y

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ewm_meanEMA 指数移动平均

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 vol_20：ret.滚动窗口(20).std()
  3. 计算 med_vol_60：vol_20.滚动窗口(60).median()
  4. 计算 regime：((vol_20 > med_vol_60).astype(int) * 2) - 1
  5. 计算 trend：close - close.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_vol_regime_smoothed_trend(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change() vol_20 = ret.rolling(20).std() med_vol_60 = vol_20.rolling(60).median() regime = ((vol_20 > med_vol_60).astype(int) * 2) - 1 trend = df_copy["close"] - df_copy["close"].ewm(span=10, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() df_copy["factor_vol_regime_smoothed_trend"] = regime * trend "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_vol_regime_smoothed_trend"]
